title: Cat trained to be office assistant - fetching documents from printer
description:
This is the funny moment a tabby cat collects its owner's paper from the printer.

Della Larca, 51, and her husband, Thomas, 53, adopted their cat, Jax, in July 2023.

When they adopted Jax, Della said he liked to fetch items and she would wake up surrounded by "gifts" - including hair ties, stuffed toys and bottle caps.

Two weeks ago, Della printed something out and Jax ran to the printer to fetch it for her.

Della and Thomas thought it was a "one off" but Jax has been running to the printer ever since.
